title: Koh Samet: nicer boats, fish and taxi
kaylee: The speedboat looks like a real boat, the ferry has toy-animal passengers who wave, the flying fish have big wing fins, and the taxi has a proper truck front with Dad sitting on the bench.

pictures.title: The speedboat
pictures.caption: A real hull with a raked bow and a foredeck, not a cone on the front

pictures.title: The ferry you pass
pictures.caption: A wooden ferry with a wheelhouse, a flag and tyre fenders; toy-animal passengers who wave as you go by

pictures.title: Flying fish
pictures.caption: Big eyes, wing fins that open as they leap and fold as they dive, a beating tail

pictures.title: The taxi's front
pictures.caption: Grille, round headlights, bumper, fenders, a windshield on pillars; the driver shows through the window

pictures.title: Dad on the taxi bench
pictures.caption: He sits back on the bench with his feet out over the edge instead of sinking into it
